name: Amnezia
author: rem-aster
description: Amnezia Premium in the Omarchy bar: pick a location, pick AmneziaWG or VLESS, connect — from a status icon and a terminal dashboard.

barWidget.description: Amnezia Premium status. Click for the dashboard (locations, protocol, devices); right click to connect or disconnect.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the icon re-reads the tunnel state. Reading it costs no network.

schema.label: Show location
schema.description: When On, the country code of the live location sits next to the icon.

schema.label: Right click
schema.description: Toggle connects to the picked location or disconnects. Nothing makes right click open the dashboard too.
